description: This file defines an interface for custom storage operations used by Orleans grains, including methods for reading state and applying updates, with generic type parameters for state and delta objects.

classes.name: ICustomStorageInterface
classes.description: A generic interface for custom storage operations in Orleans grains, supporting reading state and applying delta updates.

methods.name: ReadStateFromStorage
methods.description: Reads the current state and version from storage, returning a key-value pair with version number and state object.

methods.name: ApplyUpdatesToStorage
methods.description: Applies a list of delta updates to storage if the current version matches the expected version, returning true if successful.
